description: A named colleague is directly instructed to do a task.
text: Alex: Maria, please update the roadmap by Friday 5 PM.

description: A question directly addressed to a named owner is an assigned request.
text: Alex: Mike, can you review the vendor quote?

description: A generic question without an explicit addressee remains unassigned.
text: Maya: Can you send the latest report?

description: An imperative with no identifiable owner remains an unassigned action.
text: Ops: Please restart the staging service.

description: A deadline inside the requested action is classified explicit.
text: Priya: Please submit the report by Friday.

description: A separate timing clause in the same message is contextual.
text: Alex: Mike, can you check hotel rates? We must finalize by Monday.

description: A calendar reference alone is not promoted to an action.
text: Maya: The meeting is next Tuesday.

description: An explicit statement that no action is required is not a task.
text: Sam: We do not need to redesign the dashboard today.

description: A teammate offering help is not treated as an assigned task.
text: Sarah: I can help review the deck.

description: An acknowledgement without a visible prior task is not a new task.
text: Mike Ross: I'm on it.

description: A team-wide request is not assigned to an individual.
text: Alex: Team, please review the launch plan.

description: Two explicit requests in one message remain separate tasks.
text: Alex: Maria, update the deck. Mike, review the hotel quote.

description: A critical outage is classified high urgency.
text: Ops: Critical outage is blocking checkout. Investigate ASAP.

description: Negated urgent language is not elevated.
text: Ops: This is not urgent and no action is required.

description: A labeled decision remains separate from an action item.
text: Alex: Decision: proceed with the current launch plan.

description: A handle directly preceding a request can identify the assignee.
text: Alex: @maria please review the copy.

description: An unrelated handle mention does not become the task owner.
text: Maya: @ravi sent the file earlier. Please review the report.

description: A labeled action item can be extracted from operational notes.
text: Action item: send the signed PDF by 5 PM today.

description: An identical repeated task is deduplicated.
text:
Sam: Action item: send the final report by Friday.
Sam: Action item: send the final report by Friday.

description: A speaker name alone does not prove ownership of their request.
text: Maria Garcia: Please review the roadmap by Thursday.
